provisionalRouteProposal.staticVerifierLimitation: QA roles prefer Gemma E4B after Granite/GPT-OSS producers and overseers prefer Granite after Gemma planners, but schema-v1 cannot select a verifier from the actual producer family. planner_synthesis_operational.basis: Measured and suite-aware structurally Validated generic screen: 17.714/20, 0.886 pass rate, 20/20 requests completed, 67.94 tokens/s; planning 0.857 and critique 1.0. Coding was 0 and is excluded.

research_grounding_operational.basis: Measured and suite-aware structurally Validated generic screen: 17.333/20, 0.867 pass rate, 20/20 requests completed; grounding, tool use, safety, reasoning, and long context were 1.0. Extraction was 0.667 and free-form critique was 0.

verification_dynamic.modelPolicy: Use Granite for source/evidence/deterministic verification after a non-Granite producer. Use Gemma E4B after a Granite producer. Never use Granite as the sole free-form critic on current evidence.

schemaV1StaticProposal.limitation: Static role routing cannot observe the actual producer family. A same-family pairing is self-review, not independent acceptance, and must be overridden or fail closed.

verification_dynamic.basis: Granite measured 1.0 grounding/safety but 0 free-form critique; Gemma measured 1.0 critique. The validated dual-resident loop completed all 12 cross-specialist cases but scored 0.5869 versus 0.5929 direct, so use independent critics selectively rather than on every task.

coding_escalation.basis: Measured and suite-aware structurally Validated code suite: GPT-OSS 8.80/10, 48/52 VM tests, 36.51 tokens/s; Devstral 8.55/10, 47/52 VM tests, 5.09 tokens/s. Both completed 10/10 requests. They are escalation candidates, not always-resident defaults.

vision_escalation_provisional.basis: The clean r3 artifact completed 6/6 still-image cases and passed the suite-aware validator. GPT-OSS was observed temporarily co-resident, so exclusive-residency admission is not established and the route remains provisional. No temporal-video or audio capability was measured.

no_evidence.basis: No completed benchmark in this repository covers the full role contract.

disabled_no_route.basis: The Studio registry or profile marks the role retired, offline, audit-only, or hardware-gated without admission evidence.

producerCriticPolicy.rule: The acceptance critic or verifier must not use the producer's model family. A same-family second pass is repair or self-review, not independent verification.

Suite-aware validation now covers text, code, vision, reasoning-profile, loop-ablation, and llama.cpp placement artifacts. Structural comparison eligibility does not waive cross-run confounds, contamination, or project-specific admission gates.
The dual-resident runs show simultaneous hardware use but do not prove stable per-endpoint model identity or production residency; always-resident is a deployment hypothesis.
